title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Payer Schedule Note: Early-Refill Allowance on Sensor Supply Counted for a Plan Member Waiver
content:
# Payer early-refill allowance on CGM sensor supply

Payer Program Schedule Note, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program.

When Larkfield counts the units of the CGM supply allowance (A4239) that a plan member waiver covers for the next delivery on a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program enrollment, the payer's early-refill allowance is a number of calendar days by which the payer counts the paid-supply end of the latest refill of that item earlier.

## The allowance

The early-refill adjustment moves the paid-supply end earlier by the payer's early-refill allowance: when the latest refill carried at least one standard shipment's supply days, by one fifth of those days, rounded down; when it carried at least 30 but fewer days, by the tier's refill lead days; otherwise it does not move.

- "Those days" are the supply days of the latest refill, the refill shipment of the CGM supply allowance on the program with the latest ship date.
- "One standard shipment's supply days" is the tier's standard days of supply per refill shipment, and "the tier's refill lead days" is the tier's refill ship lead days, both as scheduled below.
- A latest refill of fewer than 30 days of supply, or no refill on record, carries no allowance: the paid-supply end does not move.

## Schedule by tier

| Tier | Standard days of supply per refill shipment | Refill ship lead days | Move for a 30-day refill | for a 60-day refill | for a 90-day refill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 30 | 7 | 6 days | 12 days | 18 days |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 7 | 6 days | 12 days | 18 days |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 10 | 10 days | 10 days | 18 days |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 90 | 10 | 10 days | 10 days | 18 days |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 90 | 10 | 10 days | 10 days | 18 days |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 30 | 7 | 6 days | 12 days | 18 days |

## Thresholds on both sides

- On a tier whose standard shipment is 30 days, a 30-day refill meets the shipment threshold: one fifth of 30 is 6 days. A refill shorter than 30 days falls below both thresholds and the paid-supply end does not move.
- On a tier whose standard shipment is 90 days, a 90-day refill meets the shipment threshold: one fifth of 90 is 18 days. A 60-day refill falls short of 90 but reaches 30, so the allowance is the tier's refill ship lead days, 10 days; a 30-day refill likewise carries 10 days.
- Rounding is downward when one fifth is taken: a hypothetical 100-day refill on a tier whose shipment is 90 days would carry 20 days, and a hypothetical 96-day refill 19 days.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

On the CGM Commercial PPO Program a latest refill of 90 days carries an allowance of 18 days. Were its paid-supply end a hypothetical 1 April, it moves 18 days earlier, to 14 March. A latest refill of 60 days on the same tier carries 10 days, so the same hypothetical 1 April would come to 22 March.
